patches.title: No Inventory After Placement
patches.principle: After placing the target object in its destination, do not check inventory or take any further actions; the task is complete.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after you have placed the object in the correct receptacle.

patches.title: Direct Clean Sequence
patches.principle: After picking up the dirty object, go immediately to the sinkbasin, clean it, then go directly to the destination and place it without any intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have picked up an object that needs to be cleaned.

patches.title: Begin Search on Countertops
patches.principle: When searching for an object to clean, start at countertop 1 — the most common open surface for household items.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a cleaning task before exploring other locations.
